name: mattermost-persian-rtl
description: A clean-room Mattermost webapp plugin for safer Persian and bidirectional text rendering.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:metadata && npm run build && npm run package && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run verify:reproducible && npm run release:assets && npm audit --audit-level=high
